text:
alex: Quick thread — organizing the pen-test evidence lifecycle + who owns what for the upcoming assessment. Need clear owners for: RBAC snapshot, audit log export, KMS-wrapped artifacts, checksum proofs, and retest handshake. Planning window: 2026-04-08 09:00-13:00 PT.

mona: I can do audit log export and checksum generation. What's the expected format and where to drop it? :thinking_face:

alex: Good — prefer consolidated gzipped JSON lines, split by service (auth, infra, runtime). Upload to assessor S3 bucket with presigned PUT. Use ephemeral role `assessor_exporter`. We'll also store SHA256 sums in a small manifest file.

jordan: For RBAC snapshot I can run the export tooling. Question: do we want a live snapshot or point-in-time DB dump? Live snapshot (roles/policies) should be enough for the assessor.

eli: We should record the snapshot timestamp and attach it to the manifest. Also do a redundancy copy to internal secure bucket for retention.

shaun: KMS concern — we must NOT give the assessor direct KMS decrypt perms. Plan: encrypt artifacts with our CMK and create a KMS-encrypted S3 envelope; then hand over the encrypted objects + wrapping key via presigned PUT to their intake bucket. We'll provide a limited-time unwrap token via KMS proxy if required.

alex: Exactly. Proposed flow (concise):
1) RBAC snapshot -> `rbac-YYYYMMDDTHHMM.json.gz`
2) Audit logs -> `service-audit-YYYYMMDD.gz` (SHA256 appended in manifest)
3) Artifacts encrypted with CMK `arn:aws:kms:...:cmk/pen-test-enc`
4) Upload to `s3://assessor-intake/<eng>/` with presigned PUTs
5) Handoff message + manifest + signed SHA256 and upload receipt in Slack channel `#pt-bridge`

alex: Example export command for logs (mona):
```bash
./infra/tools/export_logs.py --services auth,infra,runtime --start 2026-03-08 --end 2026-04-07 --out /tmp/assessor/audit-20260407.gz
sha256sum /tmp/assessor/*.gz > /tmp/assessor/manifest.sha256
```

mona: That works. I'll run a dry-run Tuesday and post size. Also, do we want the manifest signed by an engineer key? I can GPG sign it.

eli: Yes, GPG-signed manifest + timestamped S3 upload receipt is important for chain-of-custody. Put the GPG signature in `manifest.sha256.sig`.

jordan: RBAC export will be run with `--snapshot` flag to freeze roles as of the window start. I'll include a `rbac-metadata.json` with commit hashes and applied migration versions.

shaun: On the KMS proxy — infra can spin up a short-lived proxy that accepts audit-only unwrap requests from the assessor IPs. We'll limit to 1 hour tokens and log all requests to a separate audit stream. infra-bot: please tag infra runbook. :lock:

infra-bot: Runbook created: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pt-kms-proxy (ephemeral-token TTL: 3600s). Audit stream: `audit-proxy-unwraps`.

alex: Good. A few open questions before we close owners:
- Who signs off evidence packaging before upload?
- Who coordinates retest slot confirmation with the assessor?

mona: I'll sign off on packaging after checksum + signature verification.

jordan: I'll coordinate retest slots. Propose we offer two 2-hour slots next week and let them pick.

eli: Also need to map vuln triage owners: if the assessor flags something as 'critical' we want a Triage lead contact. I'll be Triage lead for this run.

shaun: Triage escalation path: Triage lead -> Oncall Eng -> Security Director. Make sure contacts are in the handoff manifest.

alex: Thanks team. Action items:
- mona: dry-run export Tue + upload presigned URL readiness
- jordan: RBAC snapshot test + retest slot proposals
- eli: prepare GPG keys and triage contact notes
- shaun/infra: KMS proxy dry-run and runbook confirmation
I'll post final handoff message in `#pt-bridge` 24h before window. :thumbsup:

mona: Noted. I'll post sizes and ETA by EOD Mon.

jordan: Will post RBAC snapshot ETA by EOD Mon.

eli: GPG key + contact file will be in `/secure/pt/keys/20260407` and I'll share the ACL with mona/jordan.

shaun: KMS proxy test scheduled Wed 10:00 PT. Will confirm logs stream is attached.

alex: Perfect — we'll call this done-for-now. If anything urgent, ping me or `#pt-bridge`.

shaun: :spiral_calendar: reminder set.

infra-bot: Evidence lifecycle checklist updated in ticket PT-4210.
